summary: Number 1 is ruled by the Sun and carries the traits and qualities of a king. People born on 1, 10, 19, or 28 possess the characteristics of both Sun and King.
full_text: People born on the 1st, 10th, 19th, and 28th of any month are governed by Number 1. The ruler of Number 1 is the Sun. title: Lo Shu Grid — Construction Method and Input Sources
summary: The Lo Shu Grid is a 3×3 magic square populated from DOB digits, Basic number (if double-digit), Destiny number, Kua number, and Full name number. Up to 8 planes (arrows) can be complete.
full_text: The Lo Shu Grid is a 3×3 Chinese numerology birth chart. Each cell corresponds to one of the nine digits (1–9). To construct a person's grid, place every digit from: (1) all digits of the full date of birth, (2) the Basic number if it is a double-digit value, (3) the Destiny number, (4) the Kua number, and (5) the Full name number. A number present in any of these inputs is marked in its corresponding cell. A number absent from all inputs is a missing number. The grid has a maximum of 8 planes — 3 horizontal rows, 3 vertical columns, and 2 diagonals — each called an arrow. A complete plane (all three numbers present) = an active arrow strength. An empty plane (all three numbers absent) = a missing arrow weakness. Each row, column, and diagonal sums to 15 (the magic sum).

title: Lucky Number Calculation — Full Algorithm
summary: Lucky numbers are derived from the intersection of Friend numbers shared by both Basic Number and Destiny Number, after striking all Non-friend numbers from both. Two sets: 1st (main) and 2nd (fallback).
full_text: To calculate Lucky Numbers: Step 1 — Derive the Basic Number (BN) and Destiny Number (DN). Step 2 — List Friends, Non-friends, and Neutral numbers for both BN and DN using the Ch5 compatibility tables. Step 3 — Build a unified strike list comprising ALL Non-friend numbers from both BN and DN. Step 4 — Remove every strike-list number from BN Friends, BN Neutral, DN Friends, and DN Neutral lists. Step 5 (1st set / Main Lucky Numbers) — Find the intersection of remaining BN Friends and remaining DN Friends. Numbers present in both are the primary lucky numbers. Step 6 (2nd set / Secondary Lucky Numbers) — From all remaining (non-struck) numbers of both BN and DN combined, find numbers common to both — this forms the secondary lucky number pool. Subtract the 1st set to get the pure 2nd set. Step 7 — Always apply the 1st set as the Lucky Numbers. The 2nd set is only used when the 1st set is empty.
